exercises.title: FE mock A — 20 questions across all chapters
exercises.problemHtml:
A mock final exam in the style of a multiple-choice FE: 10 concept questions and 10 calculations covering logic, sets and functions, Big-O, number theory, induction and recurrences, counting, graphs and trees. Set a timer for 40 minutes; calculators are not needed.

This set has 20 questions. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. The questions follow the style of the MAD101 final exam, so work them out on paper first, exactly as you would in the exam hall.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:

Bộ này có 20 câu. Không có gì để chạy: trả lời trong khung bên phải rồi bấm Nộp. Câu hỏi theo phong cách đề FE của môn MAD101, nên hãy giải ra giấy trước như khi ngồi phòng thi.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.
